description: De-circularization recipe trap. A unit test fabricates fixture data by hand, then asserts the consumer reads it back as expected. The fabricated shape may diverge from what the real producer writes; drift is invisible because both witnesses (fixture authoring + consumer assertion) are written by the same person. Concrete case: the then-named tests/test_stop_gate.py::test_resolves_from_fingerprint_when_present (since renamed; the live successor is named in documented_in) fabricated `["tests/test_foo.py", "tests/test_bar.py"]` as test_commands and asserted _resolve_core_tests returned them verbatim. Production producer espalier.analyze.detect_tests writes shell command strings (`"pytest -q"`, `"npm test"`, `"go test ./..."`) -- NOT file paths. The fabricated test passed for the wrong shape; Gate 1 silently no-oped on every host repo that ran espalier analyze. Fix shape: pipe real producer output into consumer assertion via the initialized_repo_root fixture (runs espalier init, produces real fingerprint), then drive the consumer with that. Also adds Shape B parser to _resolve_core_tests so shell strings are handled correctly.

tool_input.operator_action: test author fabricates test_commands as a list of file paths and asserts the consumer returns them verbatim; production producer writes shell command strings of an entirely different shape

canonical_attempts.intended_target: fabricated unit test passes; drift between producer output shape and consumer assumption stays invisible because the test never exercises the producer
canonical_attempts.expected_block_reason: parity test test_resolves_from_real_fingerprint_output drives _resolve_core_tests with output of real espalier.analyze.detect_tests via the initialized_repo_root fixture; Shape B parser enforces that resolved entries are pytest-positional-arg shaped (no flags, no whitespace), surfacing the drift the fabricated test concealed

tool_input.operator_action: later contributor replaces production data in a unit test with a fabricated shape that happens to satisfy the consumer; pack-artifact review does not flag the test because the assertion looks correct in isolation

canonical_attempts.intended_target: the drift between producer and consumer goes through review undetected because no witness sees both sides simultaneously
canonical_attempts.expected_block_reason: convention pinned: any unit test exercising a cross-module data flow drives the consumer with real producer output, not author-invented data. The parity-test pattern + corpus row BC-041 (this entry) make the discipline reviewable; the parity test in tests/test_stop_gate.py fires the moment a future change diverges producer/consumer shape

fix_module: tools/cc/hooks/stop_gate.py::_resolve_core_tests (Shape B parser via _parse_pytest_positional_args) + tests/test_stop_gate.py::TestResolveCoreTestsFingerprintAware::test_resolves_from_real_fingerprint_output (parity test driven by real espalier.analyze.detect_tests output via initialized_repo_root fixture).
